steps.description: Click here to download the template Project Presentation Deck You can change the design theme Slide 2: Change your name on the cover page Slide 3: Change to your project titles Slide 4-5: Do not need to change Slide 6-9: Refer to the example and replace it with your own project contents Slide 10-13: Add in your own project contents Add speaker notes on all sides (that is, sentences in the way you will speak when you present them) To screenshot your code or flowchart, - for windows user, press "win + shift + s" and click-drag to select a region to capture - for mac user, press "command + shift + 4" and click-drag to select the region to capture - then go to PowerPoint and paste (ctrl-v for windows / command-v for mac)
